user_story: As a user, I want to log in to my account using the login form so that I can access my account details and make purchases. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The login form should be accessible at the URL 'https://automationexercise.com/login'. 2. The form should contain an input field with the name 'email' and placeholder 'Email Address'. 3. The form should contain an input field with the name 'password' and placeholder 'Password'. 4. There should be a button with the text 'Login' to submit the form. 5. Upon successful login, the user should be redirected to the homepage.
